significance: The chief Tevaram shrine of the Kongu country at Avinashi, founded under the Cholas and rebuilt in stone under the Nayaks, counted among the 275 Paadal Petra Sthalams.
story: At Sundarar's hymn, a crocodile is said to have released alive the boy it had swallowed years before, an event replayed each year as the Mudalai Vaai Pillai festival.
